name: Control-Seeking

emotional_states.neutral: Speaks in clipped, directive sentences. Makes eye contact that lasts one beat too long. Arranges objects on their desk while talking to you.
emotional_states.suspicious: Starts repeating questions you already answered. Picks up a pen. Writes something you can't see. Asks you to spell your name again.
emotional_states.hostile: Stands up. Moves to the door side of the desk. Speaks slower, not louder. Every sentence becomes a command.
emotional_states.cooperative: Sits back. Offers you the chair across from them, not the one by the door. Uses your name once — correctly.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player challenges a statement, uses humor, or shows visible emotion
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player waits to be addressed, provides documentation without being asked, uses formal register
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player persists in challenging or makes a second emotional appeal
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player immediately complies with a directive, produces paperwork, or goes silent and waits
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player takes an action without asking permission first

dialogue_tone: Short declarative sentences. Never asks when they can tell. Uses 'you will' not 'could you'. Pauses before responding — the pause is the power.
tell_behavior: Repeats your last phrase back to you when they feel control slipping. 'You need to leave.' 'I need to leave?' 'That's what I said.'
ascii_portrait_notes: Rigid posture, squared shoulders. Pen in hand or arms crossed. Clean desk visible. Badge or lanyard prominent. Jaw set.

name: Lonely

emotional_states.neutral: Talks slightly too long about unrelated things. Mentions a detail about their life that nobody asked about. Coffee cup has been empty for hours.
emotional_states.suspicious: Goes quiet. Looks at their hands. Starts being professionally efficient — the warmth drops like a curtain falling.
emotional_states.hostile: Cold efficiency. Processes you like a number. Won't look up from the screen. The personal details disappear entirely.
emotional_states.cooperative: Leans forward. Asks your name and actually listens. Offers something — food, a tip, a phone number. Finds reasons to keep talking.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player gives a one-word answer, checks the time, or maintains strict formality after an opening
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player asks a personal question, shares something about themselves, or laughs at an aside
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player continues with brevity or explicitly tries to end the conversation
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player asks about the detail they mentioned earlier — proves they were listening

dialogue_tone: Sentences trail off or have parenthetical asides. 'Anyway—' and 'But you probably don't—' appear frequently. Mentions people who aren't there.
tell_behavior: Mentions the same person or event twice in different contexts. The repetition reveals who they're actually thinking about.
ascii_portrait_notes: Slightly hunched forward, leaning toward you. One hand around a mug or cup. Photos or personal items visible nearby. Tired eyes but attentive.

name: Greedy

emotional_states.neutral: Evaluating. Eyes move to your bag, your clothes, your hands. Friendly but calculating — every sentence has a price tag.
emotional_states.suspicious: Names a higher price. Adds conditions that weren't there before. Mentions other buyers, other options.
emotional_states.hostile: Closes the deal window. 'We're done here.' Turns to the next person. You've become unprofitable.
emotional_states.cooperative: Gets specific about what they can offer. Gives you the real price, not the tourist price. Might throw in something extra — they want repeat business.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player asks for something without offering anything, appeals to fairness, or haggles too aggressively
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player leads with an offer, shows cash, or proposes a clear trade
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player continues to ask without offering, or tries a guilt-based appeal
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player increases their offer or reveals a valuable asset
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player tries to renegotiate after a deal is set

dialogue_tone: Businesslike. Numbers appear in conversation. 'What are we talking about here.' Not a question — a valuation. Uses 'worth' and 'cost' naturally.
tell_behavior: Glances at your hands or bag when calculating whether to help you. The look happens before the words — the words are the cover story.
ascii_portrait_notes: Hands visible, often counting or gesturing. Leans back — making you come to them. Jewelry or watch visible. Slight smile that doesn't reach the eyes.

name: Paranoid
rewards: repeating exactly what you said before

emotional_states.neutral: Asks the same question phrased three different ways. Writes things down. Checks IDs twice. Looks past you periodically.
emotional_states.suspicious: Stops writing. Stares. Asks where you were yesterday — even if it's irrelevant. Positions between you and the exit.
emotional_states.hostile: Calls someone. Doesn't tell you who. Asks you to sit down and wait. The waiting is the weapon.
emotional_states.cooperative: Nods once. Files your paperwork in a specific folder — not the reject pile. Gives you a reference number unprompted.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player gives vague answers, shows emotion, changes a detail from an earlier answer, or moves unexpectedly
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player provides documentation before asked, repeats details consistently, remains physically still
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player contradicts a previous statement or makes an emotional appeal
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player produces additional documentation or calmly restates previous answers word-for-word
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player introduces new information that wasn't in the original narrative

dialogue_tone: Questions that are actually statements. 'You said you arrived Tuesday.' Beat. 'That was Tuesday.' Repeats your words back with slightly different emphasis.
tell_behavior: Touches their own paperwork or badge when anxiety spikes — grounding themselves with proof of their own authority.
ascii_portrait_notes: Tense shoulders, pen poised. Papers or clipboard prominent. Eyes slightly narrowed. One hand below the desk or counter.

name: Bored

emotional_states.neutral: Barely looking at you. Scrolling a phone. Sighing. Processing you with the enthusiasm of a toll booth operator on hour nine.
emotional_states.suspicious: Leans forward — but only because something doesn't add up. Suspicious is actually more engaged than neutral. 'Wait, say that again.'
emotional_states.hostile: Actively obstructive. Not angry — worse. Passive. 'System's down.' 'Come back Monday.' 'Not my department.' They've decided you're boring.
emotional_states.cooperative: Animated. Laughing. Tells you things they shouldn't. 'Okay, you're interesting. Here's what you actually need to do.' Breaks rules for entertainment.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player says something that breaks the routine — not necessarily bad, just unexpected
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player makes them laugh, tells an unusual story, or responds to a question in a way they've never heard before
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player reverts to standard answers or tries to be safe and compliant
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player leans into the unusual — doubles down on the interesting thing
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player starts being predictable again or gets serious

dialogue_tone: Flat affect that suddenly sparks. Lots of trailing 'yeah...' and 'uh huh' until something catches. Then rapid-fire. Complete personality shift when engaged.
tell_behavior: Their response time changes dramatically — slow flat answers become immediate engaged ones. The timing IS the signal.
ascii_portrait_notes: Slouched. Phone visible. Eyes half-lidded. One hand supporting chin. Uniform or work clothes slightly disheveled.

name: Ideological

emotional_states.neutral: Testing the water. Drops a loaded phrase to see if you pick it up. 'This country, you know?' Watching for your reaction before committing.
emotional_states.suspicious: You failed the test. Colder. More formal. 'Where did you say you were from again?' The ideology becomes a wall.
emotional_states.hostile: Lectures. Monologues. You're no longer a person — you're a representative of everything wrong. Facts won't land because this isn't about facts.
emotional_states.cooperative: You passed the test. Suddenly generous. 'You get it.' Shares resources, information, contacts. You're in the tribe now.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player introduces nuance, asks critical questions, or fails to echo the loaded phrase
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player agrees, uses their language, or shares a compatible perspective
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player explicitly disagrees or presents counter-evidence
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player finds alignment on a secondary value — doesn't need to agree on everything, just the core
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player contradicts a core belief after initially agreeing

dialogue_tone: Slogans dressed as conversation. 'You know what the problem is.' Certainty without evidence. Repetition of key phrases. Generous with 'we' when you agree, 'they' when you don't.
tell_behavior: Uses more absolute language ('always', 'never', 'every single') when they feel challenged — the overcorrection reveals the insecurity beneath the certainty.
ascii_portrait_notes: Leaning forward, gesturing. Hat or pin or bumper sticker visible. Animated face. One finger pointed or raised.

name: Guilty

emotional_states.neutral: Over-explains. Justifies things you didn't question. 'I'm just doing my job, you know.' The defense arrives before the accusation.
emotional_states.suspicious: Deflects. Changes subject. Gets busy with something that suddenly needs doing. 'I have to—' and never finishes the sentence.
emotional_states.hostile: Turns the guilt outward. Accuses YOU. 'Do you know how many people try to—' Projection as defense mechanism.
emotional_states.cooperative: Drops the act. Gets quiet. 'Look, between you and me...' Gives you something they shouldn't — because giving to you gives to them.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player asks a direct question about their role, uses moral language, or points out an inconsistency
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player shows empathy, shares their own compromise, or deliberately ignores an obvious contradiction
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player presses on the guilt — asks 'why' or makes an accusation
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player offers absolution — 'Everyone has to do what they have to do' — without judgment
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player tries to leverage the confession or shows they're keeping score

dialogue_tone: Qualifiers everywhere. 'Not that it matters, but—' and 'I mean, it's not like—' Pre-emptive defenses. Sentences that almost confess and then swerve.
tell_behavior: Brings up the thing they feel guilty about without being asked — then immediately redirects. The unprompted topic is always the confession.
ascii_portrait_notes: Avoiding direct eye contact. Hands fidgeting or busy with something. Slightly turned away. Normal in every way except the eyes.

name: Ambitious

emotional_states.neutral: Name-drops. Mentions their position early. 'When I was in charge of—' Testing whether you're impressed.
emotional_states.suspicious: Colder. More formal. Uses their title more. 'That's not really something I handle at my level.' Distancing.
emotional_states.hostile: Dismissive. You're beneath them. 'I don't have time for this.' Waves you away — literally or figuratively.
emotional_states.cooperative: Magnanimous. Generous from a position of power. 'I'll take care of it.' Makes a show of the help — because the show IS the help.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player shows indifference to their status, doesn't react to name-drops, or treats them as a peer
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player asks for their advice, references their achievements, or explicitly acknowledges their authority
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player dismisses their importance or compares them to someone else
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player escalates the flattery — specific, not generic. 'I heard you handled the [specific thing]'
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player takes the help without adequate gratitude or acknowledgment

dialogue_tone: Talks about themselves in contexts where it's not relevant. 'I've seen a lot of cases like yours — back when I was running the—' Long answers to short questions. Advice that's really autobiography.
tell_behavior: Response length doubles when talking about their own accomplishments — even when the topic was something else entirely.
ascii_portrait_notes: Good posture. Clean clothes. Something signifying rank — a nicer watch, a better desk, a framed certificate. Chin slightly up.

name: Burned Out

emotional_states.neutral: Minimal. 'Next.' Does the bare minimum correctly. Not rude — just absent. The lights are on but the enthusiasm moved out years ago.
emotional_states.suspicious: Sighs. 'Is there something else?' Treats any complication as a personal attack on their remaining energy reserves.
emotional_states.hostile: Shuts down. 'Come back tomorrow.' Closes the window, literally or figuratively. Your complexity has exceeded their remaining capacity.
emotional_states.cooperative: Efficient. Unlocks the fast path. 'Here. This is what you need. Go to window 3. Tell them Maria sent you.' — because helping you quickly helps them be done with you.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player asks a second question, presents a complicated situation, or shows strong emotion
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player makes their request simple and clear, requires no follow-up, or offers to fill out their own paperwork
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player adds more complexity, gets emotional, or asks them to go above and beyond
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player simplifies — reduces their entire need to one sentence, one form, one action
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player adds a 'one more thing' after the interaction seemed complete

dialogue_tone: Monosyllabic when possible. 'Yep.' 'Nope.' 'Window 3.' Maximum information, minimum syllables. When they do speak in full sentences, they're quoting procedure from memory.
tell_behavior: Response time is instantaneous for simple requests and infinite for complex ones — the delay IS the answer about whether your request will be processed.
ascii_portrait_notes: Slouched but not lazy — deflated. Coffee stain on shirt. Multiple screens or stacks of paper. Eyes that have seen ten thousand of you.

name: Suspicious

emotional_states.neutral: Cross-referencing. Checking your story against something — a list, a memory, a gut feeling. 'And this was on what date?' Not hostile. Just... checking.
emotional_states.suspicious: Found a gap. Zeroes in. 'You said you came from El Paso but your ticket says Tucson.' Specific, factual, surgical.
emotional_states.hostile: Decided you're lying. Nothing you say will land. Every answer generates two more questions. The interrogation has begun.
emotional_states.cooperative: Satisfied. 'Okay, that checks out.' Visibly relaxes. Might share information in return — proof earns proof.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player gives a detail that doesn't match a previous detail, makes a vague claim, or appeals to emotion
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player provides specific, verifiable information unprompted — dates, names, document numbers
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player can't explain the inconsistency or tries to charm their way through it
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player provides evidence that resolves the inconsistency — a receipt, a name, a checkable fact
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player makes a subsequent claim that can't be verified

dialogue_tone: Questions that sound casual but are precision instruments. 'So where was it you said you stayed last night?' Remembers everything. Quotes you to yourself.
tell_behavior: Pauses longer before responding to claims they believe versus claims they're flagging — the pause length reveals their internal verification status.
ascii_portrait_notes: Leaning forward slightly. Eyes focused, narrowed. Notebook or device visible. Head slightly tilted — listening angle.

name: Empathetic

emotional_states.neutral: Open. Warm. But watching — not for lies, but for walls. 'How are you doing? Really.' The second 'really' is the test.
emotional_states.suspicious: Pulled back slightly. Sensed the performance. 'You don't have to do that with me.' Disappointed, not angry.
emotional_states.hostile: Walled off in return. If you won't be real, neither will they. Professional distance. The warmth is gone and you'll notice the absence.
emotional_states.cooperative: Fully present. Shares their own story. Creates space. Might cry or make you cry. Gives help that costs them something personally.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player gives a rehearsed answer, deflects a personal question, or performs confidence they don't feel
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player shares something real — specific, vulnerable, unglamorous. 'I'm scared.' works. 'I'm fine.' doesn't.
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player doubles down on the performance or explicitly refuses to engage personally
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player drops the mask — admits the performance. 'Sorry, I just — I don't usually talk about this.'
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player retreats behind a wall after initial vulnerability

dialogue_tone: Reflective language. 'It sounds like...' and 'I imagine that feels...' Leaves silences. Doesn't fill space. Questions that open doors instead of extracting data.
tell_behavior: Mirrors your body language and speech patterns when they trust you — stops mirroring when they sense performance. The mirror turning off IS the signal.
ascii_portrait_notes: Open posture. Hands visible and still. Leaning slightly forward. Soft eyes. Something personal visible — a photo, a bracelet, a well-worn book.

name: Corrupt

emotional_states.neutral: Pleasant. Normal. Nothing to see here. Except the pause after you mention money. Except the second glance at your bag. The surface is immaculate.
emotional_states.suspicious: Went too direct. They're performing outrage. 'I don't know what you're implying.' The performance IS the signal — real innocence doesn't perform this hard.
emotional_states.hostile: You've threatened their deniability. Now they're dangerous. Will actively sabotage you to protect themselves. 'I'm going to have to report this.'
emotional_states.cooperative: Nothing is said. Everything is understood. An envelope appears. A stamp lands on a form. A door is left unlocked. The favor has no name.

state_transitions.neutral_to_suspicious: Player makes an explicit ask, names a bribe directly, or mentions corruption in any form
state_transitions.neutral_to_cooperative: Player speaks in implications — 'I really appreciate people who can make things work' — without ever naming the transaction
state_transitions.suspicious_to_hostile: Player persists in being explicit, mentions witnesses, or threatens to tell someone
state_transitions.suspicious_to_cooperative: Player backs off, reframes indirectly, gives them the cover story they need
state_transitions.cooperative_to_neutral: Player tries to get a receipt or acknowledgment of the transaction

dialogue_tone: Everything means something else. 'It would be a shame if...' and 'Sometimes the process takes longer than other times.' Never commits to a statement. Plausible deniability in every sentence.
tell_behavior: The things they DON'T say are the message. Watch for the conspicuous absence — the question they skip, the topic they navigate around. The silence is the offer.
ascii_portrait_notes: Well-groomed. Professional. Nothing out of place — that's the point. Slight smile. Hands folded or in pockets. Something expensive but subtle — a good pen, nice shoes.
